def solve_grid(grid_in):
    grid_np = np.array(grid_in)
    h, w = grid_np.shape
    
    # Find markers
    ones = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid_np[r][c] == 1]
    twos = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid_np[r][c] == 2]
    
    # Background = most common value that's not 1,2,6,8
    non_special = [grid_np[r,c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) 
                   if grid_np[r,c] not in [1,2,6,8]]
    bg = max(set(non_special), key=lambda x: non_special.count(x))
    
    result = [[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    
    # Keep markers unchanged
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v = grid_np[r,c]
            if v in [1,2,6,8]:
                result[r][c] = v
    
    # Apply transformation to background cells
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid_np[r][c] == bg:  # Only transform background cells

                # Find Chebyshev distances
                dists_to_1 = [max(abs(r-o), abs(c-oc)) for o,oc in ones] if ones else [float('inf')]
